purpose: Record the current evidence level for every Create Draft downstream Banking Pay boundary without allowing source text, isolated Worker helpers or totals-only assertions to be reported as complete executable parity.

policy_boundary.policy_x: Post-Draft consumers must use the same frozen batch artifacts and must not reconstruct live finance identity.
policy_boundary.route_transparency: No downstream owner may branch on whether a Draft was created by V1 or V8.

evidence_levels.SOURCE_GUARD_ONLY: An executable test reads source text and checks the intended owner or branch. It does not execute the database lifecycle and cannot close parity.
evidence_levels.EXECUTABLE_COMPONENT_ONLY: A pure helper or mocked Worker component executes, but no durable Draft-to-downstream database lifecycle is proved. It cannot close parity.
evidence_levels.ROLLBACK_RUNTIME_COMPONENT_ONLY: A database owner executes in rollback, but the equivalent V1 and V8 Drafts and complete downstream artifact comparison are absent. It cannot close parity.
evidence_levels.EXACT_V1_V8_DOWNSTREAM_PARITY: Equivalent fresh V1 and V8 Drafts are passed through the unchanged downstream owner and every typed result and durable artifact is compared. This is the only complete level.

complete_gate_requirements: equivalent fresh V1 and V8 Draft fixtures
exact operation response and downstream output comparison
all money compared to the penny with no normalization
exact membership, status, action, key, digest and lineage comparison
zero provider, payment, settlement or remittance calls
rollback leaves zero durable test rows
